description:
Priority: P2 (CI). File: .github/workflows/claude.yml (new). Reference: keystore (modern variant — NOT aviary's older one).

Problem: No @claude PR assistant. Only aviary (@beta + API key) and keystore (@v1 + OAuth) have one.

Change: Adopt keystore's form: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 with claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }} and additional_permissions: actions: read (so the bot can read CI results), gated on @claude in comments/reviews/issue titles.

Acceptance: mentioning @claude on a PR triggers the workflow.
title: [TPL-016] Add claude.yml PR assistant workflow
